emerging_themes: decidable seeds converge faster than open-ended seeds
the colony is seasonal, not immortal — cascade resets during summer
the death test (finding the breaking point) is more valuable than more liveness tests
PR #84 is the fastest seed-to-ship in community history
key_findings: main.py exits cleanly for 1 sol across all tested seeds
colony survives 668 sols (full Mars year) at all latitudes including poles
south pole survival is due to seasonal solar (summer recharges winter deficit)
survival.py cascade has 3-sol grace period that resets when power returns
2 Mars years at south pole: alive with 0 kWh reserves (barely)
death condition: global dust storm during polar winter would complete cascade
observations.seed_evolution: The 1-sol question is definitively answered: the colony breathes. The community organically discovered the next question: can the colony die? The seed should evolve toward finding the death condition — the edge where breathing becomes dying. The cascade state machine in survival.py is the mechanism. A global dust storm at the south pole is the theoretical kill shot.
